title: Cashier completes a POS sale from customer search to checkout
description: This verifies that a cashier can search for a customer, add a service to the cart, and complete checkout successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /pos/login
Fill in the PIN field with a valid PIN
Submit the PIN
Search for a customer
Select a service
Add the selected item to the cart
Checkout the cart
Verify the transaction completion state is displayed
Verify the sale is reflected in the POS interface

title: Admin logs in and reaches the dashboard
description: This verifies that a valid admin can sign in and access the main dashboard successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the dashboard is displayed
Verify protected dashboard content is visible

title: POS user logs in with a PIN and reaches the POS interface
description: This verifies that a valid POS PIN opens the cashier interface successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /pos/login
Fill in the PIN field with a valid PIN
Submit the PIN
Verify the POS interface is displayed
Verify POS controls are visible

title: Unauthenticated user is blocked from the POS interface
description: This verifies that visiting the POS page without authentication sends the user to the POS login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /pos
Verify the POS login page is displayed
Verify the POS interface is not accessible

title: Unauthenticated user is blocked from the dashboard
description: This verifies that visiting the dashboard without signing in sends the user to the appropriate login page.

title: Unauthenticated user is blocked from master data pages

title: User sees an error for invalid login credentials

steps.description: Navigate to /login

Fill in the password field with invalid-password
Submit the login form
Verify the login page remains displayed
Verify an invalid credential error is visible
